description: This file defines a custom exception class 'AcknowledgementLabelNotDeclaredException' used in a Java-based software project. The exception is thrown when an acknowledgement label that is not declared is used in a WebSocket or connectivity context. It includes methods for creating instances from labels or JSON objects, and a builder for custom construction.

classes.name: AcknowledgementLabelNotDeclaredException
classes.description: A final immutable exception class indicating an undeclared acknowledgement label error, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing AcknowledgementException, with factory methods and an inner builder class.

classes.name: AcknowledgementLabelNotDeclaredException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-safe mutable builder class for creating instances of AcknowledgementLabelNotDeclaredException with a fluent API.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an exception instance given a label and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated DittoHeaders.
